biotools.summary: Proteo-SAFARI is an R-based Shiny application designed for the identification of protein fragment ions in top-down MS/MS spectra. It provides a user-friendly interface for fragment assignment, visualization, and analysis with support for custom modifications and hydrogen-shifted fragment ion fitting.
